gloss: internal assessment score; school evaluation score

definitions.gloss: internal assessment score; school evaluation points
definitions.explanation: scores assigned by a school that reflect a student's academic performance, behavior, and activities; used in high school entrance exams

{内申点|ないしんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
JAPANESE EDUCATION SYSTEM:
{内申点|ないしんてん} is crucial for {高校受験|こうこうじゅけん} (high school entrance exams). The score is recorded in the {内申書|ないしんしょ} (school report).
